items.difficulty_reason: 31 行、四合一引理：①内 Hom 构造与局部化交换 ⇒ (1)(2) 归到仿射；affine-compare + pseudo-coherent-affine + perfect-affine 三引理再归到 (3)；②(3)：K 写成有界上（resp. 有限）有限投射模复形、L 写成有界下（resp. 任意）复形，cohomology 章的 Rhom 直接计算引理给出 R SheafHom = (R Hom_A) 的伴随层；③(4)：一般环空间上内 Hom 的第 n 上同调层是 U ↦ Ext^n 的层化，主开集 D(f) 上 K̃、L̃ 的限制是 K⊗A_f、L⊗A_f 的像 ⇒ 得到 Ext^n_{A_f} 的预层公式。承重全在 span 内；6 处引用（3 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2656-2684

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the localization of the internal hom construction allowing reduction to affines, the reduction of parts (1) and (2) to part (3) through the affine comparison and the pseudo-coherent and perfect affine lemmas, the module-level computation of the internal hom from the cohomology lemma for complexes of finite projective modules, and the presheaf description of the cohomology sheaves on principal opens (source lines 2686-2716)
